messages.subject: Kestrel interview: Staff Software Engineer
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for your interest in the Staff Software Engineer role at Kestrel. Your next interview is a 75-minute low-level design (object-oriented design) round on Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 1:00 PM PT via Zoom.

Kestrel builds storage infrastructure for trading firms.

Grace Liu, Kestrel Recruiting
